summary: Iter68 — MARTbaked supplier-centric admin workflow (Fixing_Prompt v5). Both backend + frontend all green. Backend pytest test_supplier_centric_workflow.py: 9/9 pass in 4s. Regression suites test_supplier_portal_phase2b.py + test_homepage_cms.py: 21/21 pass. Frontend Playwright coverage against live preview URL confirms every review-request bullet: (1) old routes /admin/mart-partner-approvals and /admin/partner-image-reviews redirect to /admin/modules/mart/approvals and /admin/modules/mart/suppliers respectively; (2) 'Darkstore Approvals' and 'Partner Image Reviews' items are gone from the AdminLayout left nav; (3) supplier detail workspace at /admin/modules/mart/suppliers/sup_demo_delta_seed loads Overview with supplier header, APPROVED status chip, warehouse allocation card, and audit trail; (4) Products tab shows All(23)/Pending(1)/Approved(8)/Rejected(14)/Withdrawn(0) buckets with category + subcategory + search filters (server-side — 'AUTOAPP' search returns empty because those seeded requests were auto-cleaned); (5) Review drawer opens with 'All Submitted Images (n)' gallery header + product info fields + Reject/Approve buttons; (6) Selecting a pending row reveals the floating bar with 'Bulk approve' + 'Bulk reject' buttons; bulk-approve modal exposes category-fallback dropdown + notes textarea; bulk-reject modal shows notes textarea; (7) 'Open workspace' button on approved supplier row in Applications tab correctly navigates to /admin/modules/mart/suppliers/{sid}; (8) AdminHomepageManagement Product Carousel editor exposes 'Subcategory slug (optional)' field alongside Category slug + Number of products + See-all link; (9) Homepage leak check via /api/mart/products?country=CI&category=<slug> for fruits-vegetables, dairy-eggs, snacks, bakery returns zero cross-category leaks. Router ordering fix (admin_supplier_prodreq_router registered BEFORE admin_supplier_router) verified indirectly — /suppliers/{sid} snapshot works AND /suppliers/product-requests/bulk-* endpoints resolve correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminSupplierDetail.jsx is well structured with granular data-testids (supplier-detail-tab-<code>, supplier-products-bucket-<code>, supplier-product-check-<id>, supplier-products-bulk-approve/reject/cancel/confirm, product-review-drawer). Excellent testability.

Router ordering (admin_supplier_prodreq_router before admin_supplier_router) is critical — a regression test that specifically hits /admin/modules/mart/suppliers/product-requests/bulk-approve AND /admin/modules/mart/suppliers/{sid} in the same suite (already covered by test_supplier_centric_workflow.py) provides the necessary safety net.

Bulk-approve endpoint's 'skipped' response (reason='not_pending') is verified. Recommend also covering 'missing_category' skip reason in a future test for full parity with the endpoint's advertised contract.
AdminHomepageManagement product_carousel now supports both category slug + subcategory. The field is optional and blank-safe.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The DEMO Delta workspace at /admin/modules/mart/suppliers/sup_demo_delta_seed is the reference happy-path fixture. For fresh-drawer testing, seed via POST /api/supplier/me/product-requests with the DEMO Delta supplier session, then reload the Products tab and open the Pending bucket. Router-ordering regression is guaranteed by the new pytest — if any admin_supplier_router route ever gets included before admin_supplier_prodreq_router, TestBulkActions will fail with 405/404 immediately.
